Smart Grocery Shopping: Your Secret Weapon for Better Health

Ever walked into a grocery store for "just milk" and walked out with a cart full of snacks but nothing for dinner? You aren’t alone. Dietician in Charni Road Mumbai, sees how the grocery store environment is designed to challenge our willpower.

Mastering the aisles is the first step toward mastering your health. My top Smart Grocery Buying Tips to help you shop with purpose by Nutrionist in Charni Road Mumbai Geetanjali Mengi.

1. The "Perimeter" Rule

Most whole, unprocessed foods live on the outer edges of the store—think fresh produce, lean proteins, and dairy. The inner aisles are usually where the highly processed "convenience" foods hide. Spend 80% of your time on the perimeter.

2. Never Shop Hungry

It’s a classic rule for a reason. When you shop on an empty stomach, your brain craves quick energy (sugar and refined carbs). Eat a small, protein-rich snack before you head out to keep your impulses in check.

3. Decode the Label

Don't be fooled by "Natural" or "Healthy" claims on the front. Flip the package over:

* Ingredients: Look for short lists with recognizable foods.
* Fiber & Protein: Aim for higher counts to keep you full.
* Added Sugars: Keep these as low as possible.

4. Frozen is Your Friend

Don't overlook the freezer section! Frozen fruits and vegetables are picked at peak ripeness and flash-frozen, locking in nutrients. They are often more affordable and won't spoil before you can use them.

Best Hydrating Foods to Keep Your Body Energised and Healthy
By Geetanjali Mengi, Registered Clinical Dietician Nutritionist in charni road mumbai

Staying hydrated is not only about drinking enough water—what you eat plays an equally important role. Many foods naturally contain high water content along with essential vitamins, minerals, and electrolytes that support overall health, digestion, and energy levels.

Fruits like watermelon, muskmelon, oranges, strawberries, and grapes are excellent hydrating options. With over 85–90% water content, they help replenish fluids while providing antioxidants and vitamin C, which support immunity and skin health. Coconut water is another natural hydrator, rich in potassium and ideal during hot weather or after physical activity.

Among vegetables, cucumber, bottle gourd (lauki), zucchini, tomatoes, lettuce, and spinach are hydration champions. These foods are light, cooling, and gentle on digestion, making them especially beneficial for people with acidity, kidney concerns, diabetes, or during recovery from illness.

Curd, buttermilk (chaas), soups, and broths also contribute significantly to daily fluid intake while supporting gut health. Including these foods regularly can help prevent fatigue, headaches, constipation, and dehydration-related cramps.

As a clinical dietician based in girgaon charni road , I recommend a balanced approach—combine water intake with hydrating foods tailored to your medical needs, lifestyle, and climate.

owner_posts.post_text:
Many women with PCOS in Andheri West, Mumbai struggle with weight gain, fatigue, and frequent cravings, especially while managing long work hours and daily travel. A common issue is skipping meals or depending on quick snacks between meetings, thinking it will help with weight loss.
In reality, irregular eating patterns can worsen PCOS symptoms. Skipped meals often lead to unstable blood sugar levels, low energy, and strong cravings later in the day. Over time, this can increase insulin resistance and make hormonal imbalance more difficult to manage.
Effective PCOS management is not about eating less, but about eating balanced meals. When a meal includes adequate protein, fibre-rich vegetables, and the right carbohydrates, blood sugar levels remain more stable. This supports hormonal balance, improves energy levels, and reduces frequent hunger and cravings.
For many working women with PCOS, this simple shift in how meals are structured leads to better focus, improved stamina, and more sustainable weight control. Balanced eating fits into everyday routines and supports long-term PCOS health rather than short-term restriction.
Small, consistent changes in daily meals can play a meaningful role in managing PCOS symptoms and overall hormonal health.

Hi, I had gone to Deepa Nandy’s Nutriguide after a devastating diagnosis of a chronic inflammatory disease (autoimmune) called Ankylosing Spondylitis which had been causing me severe SI joint, ankle and feet pain for some months. Little did I know back then that this decision of mine to take her consultancy would help me more than any medication or doctor could. When I went to Deepa Mam it was due to the fact I was severely overweight (130 kg bodyweight, 43% body fat) and managing the symptoms of this flare-up required me to reduce my body fat. After my diagnosis in January my medications began a few weeks later, delayed due to some medical difficulties. Initially after some improvement the relief fell completely stagnant. This time in my life was so bad it was inexplicable. There were a good 3-4 months where I had to use a walking stick just to walk at home and a good amount of time I used a walker as well. Make note although I was overweight, I was into competitive powerlifting so this phase of my life was shattering my confidence. This tunnel seemed to have no light at the end of it or so I thought. After months of trying all sorts of medications to almost no avail so much so there was a time, I was popping 10-12 pills a day even after suffering from severe cramps all across due to them.
Then after putting off the most beneficial thing for me, I decided to finally think outside of medicines and into my diet. I went to Deepa mam around end June for the first time since my predicament began. Keeping in mind till now I had looked into all possible avenues I could find online to improve my condition. After looking and assessing my condition she took some time. In about 2-3 days she came to me after researching and looking into multiple resources and figured out a diet for me. It was a low FODMAP diet which she figured out specialized for my condition. This led to cutting off of many foods which were causing my gut harm and aggravating my condition. These food items which I restricted were nowhere mentioned by my multiple doctors thus far. Me being a research student myself got me interested at this, from which I understood how fundamental my problem was and how remarkably Deepa Mam was able to obtain a connection between my condition and how a diet can help. Calling the diet helpful would not be enough to describe what it did to cure me and became like a light at the end of a long dark tunnel.
My ESR and CRP (both inflationary parameters determining how active the disease is in me) dropped to almost half within 3 weeks which were not decreasing actually increasing after months of medication. The best part was I was not losing strength as my diet consisted of all required macro and micro nutrients but reduced my excess body fat at an accelerated rate with no loss in strength or muscles. From 130 kg and 43% body fat to 102 kg at 30% body fat all this from August to December just 5 months of following Deepa Mam’s diet. I was back doing all the physical activities I love got back a sense of self after loosing it due to my inability and inaction because of my condition. All these and a reduction in the dosage and requirement of various harmful medications given due to my condition by rheumatologists.
From having to use assistance to do my daily tasks and a walker to just move around to being able to walk and stretch and get back slowly to do all the things I love and finally get back to college I would credit Deepa Mam for giving me my life back.

featured_reviews.name: Sarthak Tickoo
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came to know about Pallavi through my wife who had seen amazing results repeatedly. I opted in for a 12 cycle diet plan for weight loss and general improvement in eating habits. The diet initially seemed rather uninteresting and restrictive, however, it got significantly easier to stick to the outline very quickly that Pallavi and her assistant had charted because of my preferences and availability of groceries around me factored in.

Consequently, I could see visible changes in about a month and a half. I liked the fact that she was strict and will not go any further till your short term plan is not met and helps adjust things as your routine and health changes.

The price of the plan seemed reasonable as well given competing practitioners in the market can sometimes charge well over twice what she did. Additionally, her suggestions on my diet were mainly based on by blood profile to see what macros and micro nutrients needed to be adjusted for, and if there had to be any dietary restrictions. She and her team are also extremely accommodating, professional, and proactive which I admired. they also help you get on a maintenance diet after your course is over to help you continue your progress.

Although I have experience with losing weight in the past, I found it really hard this time around. I think what Pallavi really helped me with was educating me on food groups and how to balance out my diet by observing her suggestions and reading about specific items. All in all, it was a long-term  learning experience on top of being a guided diet plan.

Overall, I had a positive experience consulting Pallavi for the 5 months I was with her and would certainly recommend giving her methods a try.

featured_reviews.name: Mishiekka Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined Dr. Pallavi Srivastava after receiving strong recommendations from a few friends who had experienced great results under her guidance. Over time, I have followed 10 different diet plans with her. Despite a hectic schedule and multiple breaks due to vacations and work trips, I was still able to maintain my weight and even experience healthy weight loss. One of the most remarkable changes was the significant inch loss, which was clearly noticeable and earned me a lot of compliments!

What sets Dr. Pallavi apart is how easy and sustainable her diets are. She customizes the plans according to your taste preferences and daily routine, which makes it much easier to stay on track. I also struggled with extremely low iron, haemoglobin, Vitamin D3, and B12 levels — factors that made weight loss more challenging. However, with her carefully designed dietary modifications, I was able to bring all my levels back to normal.

I highly recommend Dr. Pallavi Srivastava to anyone looking for a balanced, practical, and effective approach to nutrition and wellness.
